properties.name: Ile-Ife — Birthplace of Humanity
properties.description: Sacred city where Oduduwa descended from heaven and created dry land. Birthplace of the Yoruba people and all humanity in Yoruba belief.
properties.modernStatus: Historic city, active Yoruba spiritual center

properties.name: Ogun Shrine (Ire-Ekiti)
properties.description: Sacred shrine to Ogun, the orisha of iron. Annual festival involves fire-walking and iron demonstrations. Iron is placed at crossroads for protection.

properties.name: Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove
properties.description: Dense forest along the Osun River, containing shrines, sculptures, and sacred spaces dedicated to the goddess Osun. Last remaining sacred grove.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, annual festival
